summaries.golang-node-js-impact-led: Accomplished Full Stack Developer with 3.5+ years building event-driven microservices and RESTful APIs in Go, Node.js, and TypeScript, with React front-ends and PostgreSQL across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Core contributor to four open-source products at Turbot (120+ merged PRs, 9,300+ GitHub stars) — built a Go/Gin REST microservice and a Kafka-based event-driven pipeline, and cut resource-discovery latency 70–90%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and built an internal RESTful API microservice in Go (Gin framework) for Turbot Guardrails; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline whose consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook on success; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures, hardening reliability.

Core contributor across four open-source Go products (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — 120+ merged PRs, 9,300+ GitHub stars; engineered Tailpipe features on DuckDB + Parquet that lifted log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second and eliminated out-of-memory failures.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2→v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas, refactoring resource-discovery, configuration-sync, tagging, and cleanup workflows; cut policy-code duplication ~60% via Nunjucks templating and modular imports, keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL and unblocking the Node.js runtime upgrade.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — using jsonb array elements, multi-stage CTEs, and condition-aware filters — improving query performance 40% (3 min → 1.5 min across 10,000+ resources) and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.

Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud data — proactively adopting emerging tooling to extend the platform.

work.name: Trisetra, Inc.
highlights: Built React front-end features for a 3D product-visualization SaaS — led a 60+ file user-upload workflow redesign, drove a responsive-design overhaul across mobile/desktop breakpoints, and contributed to a React 17→19 and MUI 4→7 migration.
Authored a 3D-geometry library (footprint/inner-polygon extraction) powering the furniture-placement feature, and introduced the repo's first Mocha unit-test suite with real 3D-asset fixtures.

work.name: Kredey
highlights: Used Elasticsearch for full-text and semantic search over a NoSQL Firebase-backed document-sharing platform built with React.

projects.name: Lila Tic-Tac-Toe — Real-Time Multiplayer Game
projects.description: Full-stack real-time multiplayer game built end to end in 4 days: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite front-end on Vercel; a Go-based Nakama game server on Fly.io with PostgreSQL. Server-authoritative anti-cheat over WebSocket, mode-aware matchmaking, optimistic UI, a top-10 leaderboard, and reconnect-into-active-match.
